QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] How Do You Get There? MAGIC!
QuestInfo.0: The Suspicious Sorcerer gave you a special concoction that's supposed to help you visit the afterlife. You should ask him how to use it.
QuestInfo.1:
The Suspicious Sorcerer tells you to place the magic bottle somewhere with no people around and say a special incantation. How did it go again? Oh, that's right.
      #rAccio Portalis.#k
QuestInfo.2: As you performed the incantation, you think you may have glimpsed another world, but it could have just been the fumes coming from the 'magic bottle.' Further research is required.
